retainedUi.scope: Production installed host with disposable seeded records and flags off. Exact source text/inertness, correction to revision3, acceptance to revision2 and rejection retained as EXPIRED revision2 are actual completed assertions. No dialog handle, control inventory, Save invocation, completion acknowledgement, saved file readback or release sequence is recorded. The cause of the missing matching dialog is unmeasured.
